VIJERON / CUTTING ROOM

Privacy policy

How tools, analytics, ads and consent choices work.

Tool data

Cut dimensions, panel count, fabric width, extra length and tape dimensions are processed in your browser. This site does not transmit or store those numbers on a Vijeron server.

Analytics

Google Analytics 4 measures visits and tool-use events. Events include the tool name and page language only, without input or result numbers. Measurement depends on applicable consent choices.

Ads and consent

AdSense and Google Funding Choices code may load on content pages. Ad storage, personalization and analytics storage start denied until applicable consent is obtained. Google may process data under its service policies.

Contact

Use the Vijeron contact page for privacy questions or corrections. Do not send unnecessary body measurements or personal information.

Measured Sewing

A cutting-plan guide, not a ready-made clothing pattern, sewing service or fabric-quantity guarantee.
